pins: A shape step's template reference to a step id that was never declared halts specEngineExecute with the template-operand-unresolved diagnostic and the literal <<undefined>> sentinel value, before any dispatch occurs.
scriptedOutputsShape: Ordered array of objects with fields stepId and output, consumed by dispatch call order (index 0 first). This spec has no parallel, map, or branch structure, so dispatch call order is unambiguous and deterministic. Identical shape used in uncertain-gate.json.
